VIP Galaxy Villas

Villa in Rawai
HomeSaleVIP Galaxy Villas

Renders and plans from the Keller Henson project page for VIP Galaxy Rawai Villas. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

VIP Galaxy Villas is a villa development in Rawai on Phuket's south coast by VIP Property Development Co., Ltd. (VIP Thailand Group), which also builds VIP Tropika and other Phuket projects. Listings put Rawai Beach about 0.9 km away.

Listings show 3 bedroom villas of roughly 290 to 340 sqm built-up. Sources report different unit counts and a completion around December 2026, so confirm both with us; some listings mix this project with VIP Galaxy Rawai Villas.

Starting prices are about 22.3 million baht in listings. A rental programme mentioned by one portal is not a guarantee and is not offered by us. Message us on WhatsApp for the price list.

VIP Galaxy Villas: key facts

  • VIP Galaxy Villas is a villa in Rawai, Phuket, developed by VIP Property Development Co., Ltd..
  • Units: 2–3 bedrooms, 300–785 sqm.
  • Construction status: status on request; completion listed as Dec 2026.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿22,327,200.
  • Nearest beach: Rawai Beach (0.9 km).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Rawai Beach (0.9 km); Chalong Hospital (6.3 km, straight line); Dibuk Hospital (12.0 km, straight line); Makro (3.3 km, straight line).
